## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (e.g. new physical environment, benchmark, or algorithm)
- [ ] Refactoring / performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Evaluation artifact update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project (PEP 8, type hints).
- [ ] I have verified that all unit tests pass locally (`python3 -m unittest discover tests`).
- [ ] If changing benchmark results, I have run `python3 scripts/render_readme_tables.py --check` and verified agreement.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have not committed secrets, credentials, `.env` files, or personal paths.
- [ ] Any new artifacts adhere to the $< 1\text{ MB}$ auditability limit.
